g.text: log.info("{}: Ignoring request to create worker {}, because there is already "+"a worker with that id.",nodeName,workerId)
log.info("{}: Will not run worker {} as it has expired.",nodeName,worker)

haltFuture.thenApply((KafkaFuture.BaseFunction<String,Void>)errorString->{if (errorString==null )errorString="";if (errorString.isEmpty()){log.info("{}: Worker {} is halting.",nodeName,worker);}else {log.info("{}: Worker {} is halting with error {}",nodeName,worker,errorString);}stateChangeExecutor.submit(new HandleWorkerHalting(worker,errorString,false));return null ;})
log.info("{}: request conflict while creating worker {} for task {} with spec {}.",nodeName,workerId,taskId,spec)
log.info("{}: Error creating worker {} for task {} with spec {}",nodeName,workerId,taskId,spec,e)
log.info("{}: unable to create worker {} for task {}, with spec {}",nodeName,workerId,taskId,spec,e)
log.info("{}: Worker {} was cancelled while it was starting up. "+"Transitioning to STOPPING.",nodeName,worker)
log.info("{}: Worker {} is now RUNNING. Scheduled to stop in {} ms.",nodeName,worker,worker.spec.durationMs())
log.info("{}: Worker {} {} during startup. Transitioning to DONE.",nodeName,worker,verb)
log.info("{}: Worker {} {} during startup. Transitioning to CANCELLING.",nodeName,worker,verb)
log.info("{}: Running worker {} {}. Transitioning to STOPPING.",nodeName,worker,verb)
log.info("{}: Can't halt worker {} because it is already DONE.",nodeName,worker)
log.info("{}: Can't stop worker {} because there is no worker with that ID.",nodeName,workerId)
log.info("{}: Cancelling worker {} during its startup process.",nodeName,worker)
log.info("{}: Can't stop worker {}, because it is already being "+"cancelled.",nodeName,worker)
log.info("{}: Can't stop worker {}, because it is already "+"stopping.",nodeName,worker)
log.debug("{}: Can't stop worker {}, because it is already done.",nodeName,worker)
log.info("{}: Waiting for workerCleanupExecutor to terminate...",nodeName)
log.info("{}: Waiting for stateChangeExecutor to terminate...",nodeName)
log.info("{}: Caught exception while shutting down WorkerManager",nodeName,e)
